# papertrade-ai

> Trade Papertrade BTC and ETH perps from Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and VS Code. MCP server with OAuth, non-custodial session keys and guardrails.

papertrade-ai is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
